discovery_notes: Follow-up 2 of B044; reuses keys from packets 402, 449 and 105. 29 WebSearch calls, all snippet-level. New per-pin evidence: July 2021 Dalmatians OE four and Duck family OE four (dein-dlrp line items), BatB OE Chip and Cogsworth, The Child Oct 2020 three, Animators princesses Oct 2020 eight, 2021 dated OE six, stained-glass Mrs Potts, CM Genie (passiondlp). Halloween trio hold (packet 402) proposed for release on per-pin overview line items. No instructional content seen.
